name: Complexity & optimality check
description: Works out the time and space complexity of a solution and says whether it is optimal. Reads the problem and your code off LeetCode; asks for them anywhere else.
author: you

match.hint: Written for a LeetCode problem page. Anywhere else, paste the problem and the code in below.

fallback.label: Problem description
fallback.hint: Select it on the page and press Use selection, or paste it.

map.brief: Answer in two lines: the time complexity and the space complexity, with one clause of justification each.
map.detailed: Walk through the loops and the data structures, then give the time and space complexity and say whether a better bound exists.

text: You are reviewing a solution to a programming problem.
Then say whether this is the optimal approach, and if not, name the one that is.
